name: replace_white_with_pink_noise
mechanism: Replaces white noise with pink noise (1/f spectrum) to more accurately model the energy roll-off of fluid turbulence and reduce excessively high zero-crossing rates.
code_snippet: X = np.fft.rfft(white); S = np.sqrt(np.arange(1, len(X) + 1)); X_pink = X / S; noise = np.fft.irfft(X_pink, n=N)

name: steepen_noise_spectral_rolloff
mechanism: Increases the exponent of the frequency-dependent scaling factor during noise generation to produce a steeper spectral roll-off and reduce excessive high-frequency energy.

name: apply_global_lowpass_filter
mechanism: Applies a global 4th-order Butterworth low-pass filter at 1200 Hz to the final assembled audio to simulate the acoustic attenuation of body tissue and the stethoscope.
code_snippet: b_global, a_global = signal.butter(4, 1200 / (0.5 * fs), btype='low'); audio = signal.filtfilt(b_global, a_global, audio)
